item.tib: gsang sngags ma rgyud rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i zab lam dbang chog 'dzam gling gter gyi snang ba yongs su dga' ba'i dpal
item.coloph: de ltar gsang sngags ma rgyud rgyal ba rgya mtsho'i zab don dbang gi mdor bstan 'dzam gling gter gyi snang ba yongs su dag pa'i dpal zhes bya ba/ rang gzhung gi dkyil 'khor stong dang drug brgya la nges pa'i shes rab rgyas pa/ dmu rgyal rnal 'byor nyi ma'i dbang pos 'gro ba'i don bsam te smin zhing grol bar bya ba'i thabs mchog mthar thug pa 'di nyid brtsams pa'i mthu las/ rtogs grol phun sum tshogs pa'i ye shes mthar thug pa'i ngo bo rtogs par gyur cig ces thams thad 'dul zhes pa me mo phag gi hor zla bzhi pa'i tshes bcu drug gi nyin/ sa skyong mi dbang chen po bzhugs pa'i rgyal ba lhun grub sdings su grub par bgyis pa dge legs 'phel//
